data.name: DUPLO Disney Mickey & Friends Fire Truck
data.description: The DUPLO Disney Mickey & Friends Fire Truck is a colorful building toy designed for young children, promoting imaginative play and fine motor skills through assembly and interaction with beloved Disney characters.

data.name: DUPLO Town Fun Family House
data.description: The DUPLO Town Fun Family House is an engaging building set designed for young children, encouraging imaginative play and helping develop fine motor skills. It features a variety of colorful DUPLO bricks and figures that allow children to create their own family scenarios.

data.name: DUPLO 10897 School Day
data.description: The DUPLO 10897 School Day set features colorful building blocks that inspire imaginative play, allowing young children to create their own school scenarios and engage in cooperative play.

data.description: The DUPLO 10895 Fire Station is a playset designed for young children, featuring colorful bricks and accessories that encourage imaginative play and storytelling. data.name: Siku City

data.name: FurReal Friends Doodle the Cool Pup
data.description: FurReal Friends Doodle the Cool Pup is an interactive plush toy that responds to touch and sound, providing children with a fun, engaging pet-like experience.

data.name: Munchkin Bath Toy Organizer

data.name: Little Tikes Cozy Coupe (New Generation)
data.description: The Little Tikes Cozy Coupe (New Generation) is a classic ride-on toy designed for toddlers and preschoolers, encouraging imaginative play and outdoor activity. data.name: Little Tikes Cozy Truck
data.description: The Little Tikes Cozy Truck is a ride-on toy designed for young children, featuring an interactive driver's seat, a working tailgate, and durable construction for both indoor and outdoor play.

data.name: Strider 12 Sport Balance Bike
data.description: The Strider 12 Sport Balance Bike is designed for young children to develop essential balance and coordination skills without the need for pedals. This lightweight bike promotes confidence and independence as children learn to ride.

data.name: Strider 14x Sport
data.description: The Strider 14x Sport is a balance bike designed for children aged 3 to 7 years. It promotes early riding skills by allowing kids to learn balance and coordination without the need for pedals.
